description: Most of my work revolves around backend-heavy applications involving APIs, authentication systems, real-time communication, workflow management, and SaaS platforms.

title: How I Approach Development
description: I prefer understanding the actual problem before designing the solution. My focus stays on usability, maintainability, and building systems that work reliably in practical environments.
I believe software should simplify operations instead of creating unnecessary complexity.

title: Independent Product Building
description: Building products independently taught me how technical decisions connect with real-world usage, user expectations, operational limitations, and product adoption.
Working independently strengthened both technical and product thinking skills.

title: Backend Engineering Focus
description: Backend development is the area I enjoy the most. I like designing APIs, handling workflows, structuring systems, and improving reliability in applications.

title: Product Thinking
description: Real-world product development helped me understand that successful systems require more than just code. Adoption, usability, trust, and workflow fit matter equally.
I try to balance technical implementation with practical usability.

title: Vision
description: My long-term goal is to build reliable software systems that solve practical operational problems while remaining simple, maintainable, and accessible.
I want to continue improving as a backend-focused developer while building meaningful products grounded in real-world use cases.

title: Beyond Coding
description: I enjoy understanding how systems behave in real environments — from technical workflows to user interaction patterns and operational constraints.
For me, development is not only about writing code, but also about building systems people can actually use effectively.
